items.name: Gem-Warden's Visor Charm
items.lore: A shard of the Gem-Warden's visor of light, gone dark.

items.name: Cloak of the Dark Tower
items.lore: Night-blue, for those who put out the Gemstone Tower. Only its quartermaster has them.

items.name: Keener's Lamp Ring
items.lore: A ring with a tiny lamp on it, never lit.

items.name: Dark Gem Torc
items.lore: A chip of the red gem, set in bronze. It's cold now.

items.name: Causeway Bracer
items.lore: Bog-oak from the siabra causeway, banded in iron.
